name: Embystat
description: EmbyStat is a web analytics tool, designed to provide insight into website traffic and user behavior.
composeYaml:
services:
  embystat:
    image: 'lscr.io/linuxserver/embystat:latest'
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Europe/Madrid
    volumes:
      - 'embystat-config:/config'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - curl
        - '-f'
        - 'http://127.0.0.1:6555'
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 15
